landing.heroTitle: Describe an idea. Hear a song.
landing.heroSubtitle: Sonaria turns your descriptions into original instrumental music. Pick a style, shape the mood and instruments, and download your track.
landing.stylesSubtitle: Starting points for your next idea.
landing.style_ambient_desc: Wide textures, pads and room to think.
landing.style_cinematic_desc: Sound scenes with tension and release.
landing.examplesSubtitle: Descriptions you can copy and adapt.
landing.example1: Slow piano and warm pads, a rainy night atmosphere in the city, 90 BPM.
landing.example2: Lo-fi beat with vinyl crackle, soft electric guitar and a morning café ambience.
landing.example3: String orchestra building to a crescendo, rising tension, bright ending.
landing.pricingSubtitle: You pay per generation. Each model lists its cost in credits.
landing.pricingNote: Packages will be published before the public launch.
landing.faq_a1: Yes. In this version Sonaria generates instrumental music only.
landing.faq_q2: What happens if a generation fails?
landing.faq_a2: Reserved credits are returned automatically. Failed generations are not charged.
landing.faq_a3: Usage and licence conditions are set out in the terms. Review them before using a track commercially.
landing.faq_a4: Yes, from your library, in the format the chosen model delivers.
